For over two decades, the legendary MMORPG landscape has captured the hearts of millions. Many
players find themselves longing for the classic adventures that defined their early digital
experiences. Today, [Ragnarok Online p-servers][15] offer a vibrant way to relive those golden
moments while connecting with a dedicated global community.

[Ragnarok Online p-servers]

These player-managed environments keep the spirit of the original game alive through custom features
and active updates. Whether you are a veteran returning to familiar lands or a newcomer curious
about the hype, these platforms provide a unique space to explore. Choosing the right home for your
*Ragnarok online gaming* journey ensures you enjoy a balanced and exciting adventure.

By joining these community-driven worlds, you gain access to a nostalgic experience tailored by fans
for fans. It is truly the perfect time to jump back into the action and forge new memories with
friends.

### Key Takeaways
* Discover how community-managed platforms preserve the legacy of classic MMORPGs.
* Experience unique gameplay modifications that enhance the original adventure.
* Connect with a passionate, global community of like-minded players.
* Find the perfect balance between nostalgia and modern quality-of-life improvements.
* Learn why these private environments remain a top choice for dedicated enthusiasts.

## The Evolution of Ragnarok Online p-servers

The journey of **Ragnarok Online p-servers** reveals a fascinating story of player-led innovation.
What began as a single official experience has blossomed into a vast, diverse ecosystem that keeps
the spirit of the game alive for thousands of fans.

### From Official Roots to Community Innovation

In the early years, players were limited to the vision provided by official publishers. However, as
the community grew, many felt that certain aspects of the game needed *fresh perspectives* and
faster updates.

This desire for change led to the rise of **RO private servers**. These independent platforms allow
developers to iterate on the base game in ways that official publishers often overlook. By modifying
drop rates, adjusting class balance, and introducing custom events, these administrators create
unique experiences that feel both familiar and exciting.

### Why Players Seek Out Private Alternatives

Many gamers turn to these alternatives because they crave a specific type of gameplay that is no
longer available on official channels. Whether it is the **nostalgia of pre-renewal mechanics** or
the need for a more balanced competitive environment, these servers provide exactly what the
community demands.

Players often find that **Ragnarok Online p-servers** offer a more personal touch. Administrators
are frequently active members of the community, which leads to faster bug fixes and a more
responsive development cycle. This dedication ensures that the game remains vibrant and engaging for
long-term fans.

## Webshop and Cloud

## ALSO has the right offer for you

Create holistic IT solutions with ALSO. Innovative applications from IoT to AI, from cybersecurity
to gaming. Sustainable processes and competent services. And all from a single source.

Learn more about our company, our strategy, and our approach towards sustainable IT.

* [Discover ALSO][89]

## Webshop for IT partners

### Intelligent IT Supply

[Two people in a warehouse looking at a tablet together]

Find everything you need for your customers' IT in our shop. And with our e-commerce services, you
can integrate the products directly into your own shop system. Or even easier, simply use
**myStore,** the white-label solution for your digital marketplace.

Buy smart. Sell smart.

* [Explore our webshop][90]

## Cloud

### Marketplace, Gaming Place, IoT, AI, Cybersecurity

[Two people in a datacenter discussing solutions ]

### From technology to solution

Our solutions stack runs deep.

Expand your business with Everything-as-a-Service (XaaS), cloud solutions with ALSO Cloud
Marketplace, and platforms for AI, IoT, virtualization, and cloud gaming.

And our value-added services support you with such complex issues as migrations, automation or
security concepts.

* [Explore our Cloud][91]

## Value Added Services

### Discover the services behind the technology

[Woman presenting statistics to a group of people in a meeting room]

### A partnership with ALSO positions your business at the center of an extensive ecosystem

Experience personalized service backed by teams of experts and a vast array of solutions such as

* Professional Services,
* Finance and Logistics Services,
* Premium Support,
* Cloud Management Services, and
* Migration Assessments.

We’ll keep you connected, competitive, and support your business across the digital landscape and
throughout the cloud.

* [Explore Value Added Services][92]

specialist tech stores and independent retailers to deliver market coverage and accessibility to
consumers. With a focus on demand generation, we possess dedicated resources in our sales and
marketing teams to drive vendor objectives.

#### Commercial Distribution

strives to deliver the best solutions and products for your business. Lead generation, events, and
outbound marketing services are part of our extensive brand offerings and services to help you win
deals and grow your business.

assist brands with the expansion of their online businesses and logistics operations in Singapore.

vendors to optimize their digital channels to maximize online visibility and drive conversions.

Going beyond traditional distribution models of “box-moving” services. Our Marketing and Product
teams are key drivers in delivering vendor objectives and managing brand portfolios in-country.

segments to enhance and expand our range.

creating value to our vendors and customers alike.

approach in Events, PR, Channel Marketing, Digital Marketing and Social Media.

of delivery vehicles, we provide end-to-end logistic solutions for our vendors and customers.

Our shipping department also manages inbound and outbound shipments from our network of vendors
around the world.

#### After Sales Service


Leveraging on our expertise and knowledge on IT products, we offer aftersales services in terms of
repairs and replacement according to warranties offered by manufacturers.

Our technical support team operates hotlines and walk-in service centers at our office locations
regionally to fulfil product support queries.

### Why Bluechip

Bluechip thrives with solutions and technology in Australia & New Zealand, providing leading
business solutions for our value-added resellers, managed service providers, integrators and
consultants.

Our customers need end-to-end solutions for their network, security and cloud services to achieve
their transformation goals. Bluechip’s commitment is to create value for our Partners and their
customers by focusing on business outcomes delivered by technology through this journey.

[Learn More][33]
[Businessman,Hand,Touching,Map,Point,,,Global,Network,Communication,Technology]

### Leading Innovative Solutions

Established in 2000, Bluechip Infotech focuses on delivering the latest IT products to a wide
channel base while maintaining a dedicated commitment to first-class service. With offices across
Australia and New Zealand, we’re able to back our commitment to service through localised support.

Show MoreShow Less
[About Bluechip IT][34]

### Supporting Our People & Partners

Bluechip invests in its people and their education. You have the leverage to staff from various
backgrounds who can support your business with their diverse blend of industry skills and
experience.

Education and communication have powered us to stay ahead of the technology spectrum and keep our
partners and people up to date delivering the best of solutions and services.

Coupling these traits keep Bluechip IT a step ahead in supporting all our IT Reseller and MSP’s to
achieve and win business by providing them not only a solution but a gateway to untapped
possibilities.

Show MoreShow Less
[Learn More][35]

### Helping Your Business Grow

Forming optimal strategies and collaborating with more than 50 major technology vendors enables
Bluechip IT to offer our channel partners the best-in-class products, solutions, and services.

Our partnered vendors are industry leaders when it comes to IT hardware, software, telephony and
electronic security solutions.

Our value-added product management team has extensive vendor expertise, which provides turnkey
solutions from consulting, procuring, training, and right down to deployment of a project. This
allows us to support and contribute to our resellers to succeed.

Aiwa 1951’de kurulan köklü bir Japon markasıdır. Aiwa bir tüketici elektroniği şirketidir. Şirket
Japon milli şirketi olarak kurulmuş olup hoparlör, boombox ve stereo sistemleri gibi ses ürünleri
ile bilinen küresel olarak saygın bir markadır. 2015 yılında şirketin isim hakları ABD merkezli Hale
Devices, Inc. tarafından satın alınmıştır ve şirket Aiwa Corporation adını almıştır. Datagate AŞ
olarak markanın tek resmi Türkiye distribütörüyüz. Gün içerisinde dilediğiniz alanda, seyahat
ederken ya da aktif bir şekilde dinlenme esnasında müzik dinlemenin doyasıya keyfine **Aiwa **
ürünleri ile varabilirsiniz. Müzik dinleyerek aynı zamanda ruhunuzun dinlenmesine ve beslenmesine
olanak sağlayabilirsiniz. Aktivitelerinizi yaparken dinlediğiniz müzikler daha keyifli zaman
geçirmenize yardımcı olur. Keyfinizi üst noktalara taşıyabilir ve daha verimli sonuçlar elde
edebilirsiniz. Aiwa ailesinde birçok farklı seçeneğe sahip müzik sistemleri bulunmaktadır. Ürün
seçenekleri arasından yapacağınız seçimler ile sizler de gün içerisinde müzik dinleme keyfinizi
taçlandırabilirsiniz. Spor yaparken veya yolculuk esnasında kulaklıklarınızı takarak farklı bir
atmosfere bürünebilirsiniz. Bunun için kolaylıkla kullanabileceğiniz Aiwa ürünleri sayesinde farklı
deneyimler kazanabilirsiniz. Siz de üstün ses teknolojisine sahip Aiwa ürünleri sayesinde müzik
zevkinizi taçlandırabilirsiniz. Müzik seti ya da ses sistemine sahip müzik çalarlar müzik ziyafetini
artırmak için tasarlanmıştır.

**Aiwa Müzik Sistemleri ile Yüksek Ses Kalitesi**

**Aiwa müzik seti** günümüzde teknoloji ile gelişen ses cihazlarını üretmiştir. İstediğiniz zaman
istediğiniz yerde keyifle müzik dinlemenize yardımcı olmaktadır. Aiwa müzik seti daha büyük görünüme

Aiwa 1951’de kurulan köklü bir Japon markasıdır. Aiwa bir tüketici elektroniği şirketidir. Şirket
Japon milli şirketi olarak kurulmuş olup hoparlör, boombox ve stereo sistemleri gibi ses ürünleri
ile bilinen küresel olarak saygın bir markadır. 2015 yılında şirketin isim hakları ABD merkezli Hale
Devices, Inc. tarafından satın alınmıştır ve şirket Aiwa Corporation adını almıştır. Datagate AŞ
olarak markanın tek resmi Türkiye distribütörüyüz. Gün içerisinde dilediğiniz alanda, seyahat
ederken ya da aktif bir şekilde dinlenme esnasında müzik dinlemenin doyasıya keyfine **Aiwa **
ürünleri ile varabilirsiniz. Müzik dinleyerek aynı zamanda ruhunuzun dinlenmesine ve beslenmesine
olanak sağlayabilirsiniz. Aktivitelerinizi yaparken dinlediğiniz müzikler daha keyifli zaman
geçirmenize yardımcı olur. Keyfinizi üst noktalara taşıyabilir ve daha verimli sonuçlar elde
edebilirsiniz. Aiwa ailesinde birçok farklı seçeneğe sahip müzik sistemleri bulunmaktadır. Ürün
seçenekleri arasından yapacağınız seçimler ile sizler de gün içerisinde müzik dinleme keyfinizi
taçlandırabilirsiniz. Spor yaparken veya yolculuk esnasında kulaklıklarınızı takarak farklı bir
atmosfere bürünebilirsiniz. Bunun için kolaylıkla kullanabileceğiniz Aiwa ürünleri sayesinde farklı
deneyimler kazanabilirsiniz. Siz de üstün ses teknolojisine sahip Aiwa ürünleri sayesinde müzik
zevkinizi taçlandırabilirsiniz. Müzik seti ya da ses sistemine sahip müzik çalarlar müzik ziyafetini
artırmak için tasarlanmıştır.

**Aiwa Müzik Sistemleri ile Yüksek Ses Kalitesi**

###### Fabricantes

Somos la mejor opción para las principales marcas, que depositan su confianza en nuestro amplio
conocimiento de la industria para expandir su alcance en la región.

[Ver Más][43]

###### Retailers

Transforma la experiencia del cliente en el punto de venta.

[Ver Más][44]

###### Canales de valor agregado

Los clientes son la fuerza que impulsa a nuestra organización. El crecimiento de nuestros clientes
es nuestro principal objetivo.

[Ver Más][45]

###### Operadores

Para los operadores líderes en telecomunicaciones, el hecho de mantenerse enfocados en su propio
negocio jamás debería ser un desafío.

[Ver Más][46]

### Almacenamiento

Potencializa la demanda regional en localizaciones estratégicas a través de nuestro inventario de
disponibilidad inmediata especialmente concebido para garantizar la reposición y entrega expedita de
productos.

### Selección, empaque, flete y facturación

Intcomex dispone de un procedimiento flexible de selección, empaque y despacho con el fin de
preparar todo tipo de pedidos, sin importar su complejidad.

### Servicios de aduana e importación

La complejidad del comercio internacional jamás debe limitar la magnitud de tu participación en el
mercado.

### Seguimiento de pedidos


Gracias a nuestro sistema de gestión y seguimiento, es posible conocer el estatus de pedidos en cada
etapa del proceso de envío hasta que estos sean recibidos en su destino en perfectas condiciones y
en la fecha programada.

### Distribución local de mercancía


Nos encargamos de entregar tu producto donde lo necesites, a tiempo y dentro de tu presupuesto.
Contamos con una cadena de distribución fiable basada en una red de transporte y en la optimización
de rutas.

### Logística inversa


El fabricante por lo general gasta un porcentaje significativo de su ingreso total en procesar
devoluciones. El ciclo de la cadena de distribución no termina necesariamente con la entrega de
productos en su destino final.

###### Fabricantes

Somos la mejor opción para las principales marcas, que depositan su confianza en nuestro amplio
conocimiento de la industria para expandir su alcance en la región.

[Ver Más][43]

###### Retailers

Transforma la experiencia del cliente en el punto de venta.

[Ver Más][44]

###### Canales de valor agregado

Los clientes son la fuerza que impulsa a nuestra organización. El crecimiento de nuestros clientes
es nuestro principal objetivo.

[Ver Más][45]

###### Operadores

Para los operadores líderes en telecomunicaciones, el hecho de mantenerse enfocados en su propio
negocio jamás debería ser un desafío.

[Ver Más][46]

### Almacenamiento

Potencializa la demanda regional en localizaciones estratégicas a través de nuestro inventario de
disponibilidad inmediata especialmente concebido para garantizar la reposición y entrega expedita de
productos.

### Selección, empaque, flete y facturación

Intcomex dispone de un procedimiento flexible de selección, empaque y despacho con el fin de
preparar todo tipo de pedidos, sin importar su complejidad.

### Servicios de aduana e importación

La complejidad del comercio internacional jamás debe limitar la magnitud de tu participación en el
mercado.

### Seguimiento de pedidos


Gracias a nuestro sistema de gestión y seguimiento, es posible conocer el estatus de pedidos en cada
etapa del proceso de envío hasta que estos sean recibidos en su destino en perfectas condiciones y
en la fecha programada.

### Distribución local de mercancía


Nos encargamos de entregar tu producto donde lo necesites, a tiempo y dentro de tu presupuesto.
Contamos con una cadena de distribución fiable basada en una red de transporte y en la optimización
de rutas.

### Logística inversa


El fabricante por lo general gasta un porcentaje significativo de su ingreso total en procesar
devoluciones. El ciclo de la cadena de distribución no termina necesariamente con la entrega de
productos en su destino final.

### Your Trusted Technology Catalyst for Better Bigger Faster Implementation

## Welcome to SAVEX

Your trusted ICT distribution partner with over 38 years of legacy in the industry. As one of the
prominent leaders in the distribution and technological solutions industry, Savex is determined to
deliver a quality experience to satisfy our clients with our services and facilitate businesses to
succeed in the current age of digital evolution.

Savex Technologies is headquartered in Mumbai, with 107 sales offices  and 42 stocking locations
strategically spread across different regions of India.

This extensive reach, helps us to cater over 12,000 customers monthly, reaching out to over 1000
cities nationwide.

With the commitment to serve excellence, we bring to the table, and the market, top quality
distribution and technological solutions.

adverse effects.

On 15 July 2026, we became aware that our IT environment had been accessed unlawfully by an

information was accessed and potentially exfiltrated.

We commenced an investigation immediately with the assistance of external forensic specialists. We
are taking the necessary steps to contain, assess and remediate the incident and to restore the
integrity of our information systems.

The identity of the unauthorised party is not known at this time, but is suspected to be affiliated
with the DragonForce ransomware group.

**What personal information may have been affected?**

The scope of the compromise is still under investigation. We are working to analyse the types and
categories of personal information that may be affected and will issue further guidance as soon as
possible.

The affected data may include personal information relating to customers, business contacts, service
providers, employees or other individuals whose information was held within the affected IT
environment.

**What have we done?**

We take the privacy and security personal information extremely seriously. We have notified the
Information Regulator (South Africa) and have implemented various technical measures to strengthen
the security of our IT systems, apply enhanced monitoring and threat intelligence measures and to
ensure the protection and security of information.

We are working closely with external specialists to progress the investigation and to comply with
our legal and regulatory obligations. We are also liaising closely with the Board of our parent
company, Mustek Limited, on the investigation and remediation of the incident.

A SENS announcement has been submitted by Mustek on the 22nd of July 2026.

**What are the possible consequences?**

A security compromise impacting personal information can give rise to risks including fraud,
phishing or social engineering attacks, identity theft or other types of cybercrime.

requests for personal information and only disclose it when there is a legitimate reason to do so.

# Siewert & Kau Technologies – Innovation trifft Erfahrung

## Strategische Neuausrichtung mit klarem Zukunftsblick

Mit Siewert & Kau Technologies starten wir in eine neue Ära – immer noch mit derselben Leidenschaft
für IT, die Sie von uns kennen. Unser Hauptsitz bleibt in Bergheim, und auch in Zukunft führen
Oliver Kau und Björn Siewert das Unternehmen mit großer Erfahrung und Engagement.

Als zuverlässiger Partner im B2B-Bereich bieten wir Ihnen ein starkes Portfolio an Hardware,
maßgeschneiderte Lösungen und einen Service, auf den Sie zählen können. Entdecken Sie unser
erweitertes Angebot und profitieren Sie von unserer langjährigen Expertise.

Möchten Sie mehr erfahren? Legen Sie ganz unkompliziert ein [Kundenkonto][27] an oder nehmen Sie
[Kontakt][28] mit unserem Vertriebsteam auf – per Kontaktformular oder direkt über unsere Hotline.
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Anfrage!

Reseller Park und Visual eines modernen Messestands.]

Softcell

# Softcell Technologies Global Pvt. Ltd.

Softcell is one of India's leading System Integrators with over 35+ years experience in this domain.
Our 750+ strong team spread over 6 offices serve 3000+ enterprise customers in the areas of IT
Security, Mobility, Optimised IT Infrastructure, Cloud and Engineering Services. In addition to
supply of software licenses and hardware, we also provide solution design, implementation and
post-sales support services - on call, on-site and from our Data Centres. Softcell's revenue for the
year ended March 2025 was Rs. 1024 crore.

###### OUR SERVICES

#### IT Security
* Endpoint Security, Network Security
* Data Security, Cloud Security
* Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing - VA / PT
* Simulation Attack & Assessment Exercise
* Digital Forensic Services

[ Read more][102]

#### Optimised IT Infrastructures
* Data centre, Private cloud
* Edge computing, Server & Storage Networking

[ Read more][103]

#### Cloud
* Secure Email, Web Hosting
* FTP Hosting, Security Solutions
* DNS Services, Remote Monitoring

[ Read more][104]

#### Apple
* **Products** - iPhone, iPad and Mac
* **Services **- Enterprise Leasing, Employee Purchase, MDM

[ Read more][105]

#### Engineering Services
* CAD,CAM, PDM, PLM & SLM
* Tolerance Analysis
* Simulation - CAE & CFD
* IoT, AR & Industry 4.0

[ Read more][106]

#### What's New?

Softcell announces the launch of its new Remote Monitoring Services. We can monitor both your
security and network devices as well as your critical servers 24x7 from our Tier 3 Data Centre.

[ Read more][107]

#### Expert Talk

This month's expertalk is about Ransomware Protection.

[ Read more][108]

###### Helping you find the right IT solutions.

###### Mobility Use Cases

Softcell has helped customers in Aviation, Manufacturing, Consulting and Pharma, to leverage the
power of mobile devices to bring about digital transformation.

[ Read more][109]

###### Moving to the cloud

Whether you are contemplating a move to the cloud or have extensive presence on the cloud already,
Softcell can help develop your cloud strategy in the areas of security.

# Regional Distributor with Global expertise

Powering Telecom Success Across CEE and Beyond. With a unique blend of global partnerships and deep
regional insight, we deliver end-to-end telecom solutions across Central and Eastern Europe. From
market entry and brand strategy to logistics, financing, and aftersales care — our integrated
platform drives performance, scale, and speed for our partners. Let’s redefine what regional
distribution can do.
